title: Alain Guay
text:
I am a Professor of Economics at the Université du Québec à Montréal. My research is in macroeconomics and econometrics, with a particular focus on the identification of structural VARs and on understanding cyclical fluctuations.
Recent work looks at identification through higher-order moments and at spectral methods for non-Gaussian SVARs. You can find current projects on the working papers page.

title: Teaching
text:
Master’s level. The general linear regression model; generalized least squares and maximum likelihood estimation; multicollinearity, specification error, autocorrelated residuals, stochastic regressors and measurement error; distributed lag and autoregressive models; systems of simultaneous equations.




Doctoral level. Estimation and inference problems specific to macroeconometrics: specification tests, univariate and multivariate stationary time series, non-stationarity and cointegration, dynamic adjustment models, GMM and simulated method of moments, and numerical simulation methods. Applications are drawn from current debates in real, monetary and financial macroeconomics.
